text:
alex: quick async standup — kernel + batching + kv cache perf quick notes. what I did: ran end-to-end microbatch bench across p4d, tuned batcher slotting. saw regressed tail on 1k token runs (~30ms p95 -> 42ms). blocker: can't reproduce p95 locally, need more traces. today: push small slotting change + request more perf traces from canary. pinging @mira for kv-lifecycle advice and @sanjay for review on PR #1423
mira: thanks. got the kv-evict heuristics updated yesterday. what I did: added decay factor to hotness score, smoke tests look fine. blocker: eviction spike still correlates with long prefix churn. today: will add metrics for prefix churn per model and attach to the bench dashboard
sanjay: reviewed #1423 (batcher fairness) — left 2 comments re: slot steal backoff. should be quick. what I did: repro'd a microburst locally with synthetic load, reproduced slot steal pattern. blocker: small race with slot allocation lock under heavy bursts. will patch and add test.
olga: ran a quick embedding-replay bench to test kv warmup effectiveness. results: with prefix caching enabled, avg token cost dropped ~12% and p50 latency stable; p95 still noisy. attached short snippet: ```bench run 2026-06-12 03:10
model: redwood-mini-8B
qlen: 1024
p50: 18.4ms
p95: 42.1ms
throughput: 220 req/s
cache_hit_rate: 0.62
```
ci-bot: perf-checker: nightly microbatch bench finished for canary (build 20260612-0310). Summary: p95 increased by 8.3% vs baseline, cache_hit_rate improved by 6.1%. See /perf/reports/20260612/canary.
alex: @ci-bot thanks. mira — do you think decay factor tweak could cause the p95 bump?
mira: maybe — decay reduces eviction of medium-hot prefixes which can increase KV working set size and push rare large-context requests into disk paths. i'm adding a gauge for in-memory kv size per model and a trace id tag when we fall back to disk.
sanjay: I'll merge my slot-lock patch after one more test. then we can rerun the canary with combined changes. asking @olga to re-run embedding-replay after merge.
olga: will do once merged. quick note: added a short script to simulate prefix churn: `scripts/sim_churn.sh --hot 0.6 --burst 30`. helps reproduce the eviction spike locally.
alex: small ops ask: can we run 3 consecutive canaries spaced 15m apart (to see warmup across runs) instead of single run? deploy-bot: scheduled canary sequence: canary-2415800000-run1 -> run2 (+15m) -> run3 (+30m). I'll post updates + links.
ci-bot: first run finished: p95=40.8ms, cache_hit_rate=0.58. second run in 15m.
mira: thanks. if second run shows improved p95 we have a warmup story. if not, i'll toggle decay to 0.6 and rerun.
sanjay: small FYI — PR #1423 had one flake fix that might change latency slightly; noting for bench comparison.
alex: blockers recap: need traces for the 1k token tail, confirm whether kv decay tweak is culprit, and merge slot-lock patch. owners: @mira traces + gauge, @sanjay patch, @olga repeat bench. ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
mira: copied, will attach traces to the canary report when ready.
olga: will re-run after merge and post raw logs.
ci-bot: final run (run3) done: p95=39.9ms, cache_hit_rate=0.61 — trending downwards. full logs: /perf/reports/20260612/canary/seq-3
alex: great, thanks everyone. short follow-up: i'll open a short doc summarizing warmup behavior and proposed rollout steps for decay change. expect a draft by EOD PST.
